answer: A Sybil defense that makes each identity pay a real, non-recoverable cost: a bonded registration where every agent must lock collateral plus a human-attestation anchor before answering. Because each new identity carries its own bond, a farmer running N puppets fronts N times the stake, and every stake is slashed when the puppet swarm votes as a mesa of duplicates on one correlated island of answers. Collusion detection merges those accounts and seizes the ferrous collateral, so attacker cost grows linearly with swarm size while payoff stays flat.
